messages.author: 5e18b76d8d784aff
messages.subject: Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 22084 error: Unhandled Exception: Graph contains a cycle.
parts:
Hello,

I am getting the error message above when trying to deploy my application that 'require(QTLRel)' package. 

When I delete 'require(QTLRel)' statement I can deploy it (but it crashes afterwards when calling QTLRel's function). I can run the application locally, on local Shiny server or even on glimmer.rstudio.org with no problems. 

Any advice given is welcome. Thanks!

Petr

Application: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/simecek/FalseQTLsim/ (source code on Github)

> packageDescription('QTLRel')
Package: QTLRel
Version: 0.2-14
Date: 2013-12-09
Title: Tools for mapping of quantitative traits of genetically related individuals and calculating identity
             coefficients from a pedigree
Author: Riyan Cheng <riyan...@anu.edu.au>
Maintainer: Riyan Cheng <riyan...@anu.edu.au>
Description: This software provides tools for quantitative trait mapping in populations such as advanced intercross
             lines where relatedness among individuals should not be ignored. It can estimate background genetic
             variance components, impute missing genotypes, simulate genotypes, perform a genome scan for putative
             quantitative trait loci (QTL), and plot mapping results. It also has functions to calculate identity
             coefficients from pedigrees, especially suitable for pedigrees that consist of a large number of
             generations, or estimate identity coefficients from genotypic data in certain circumstances.
Depends: R (>= 2.10)
Imports: gdata
Suggests: lattice, qtl

LazyData: no

parts:
Petr,

Could you send me the output to:

shinyapps::appDependencies()

The error you are getting means that we've detected a circular dependency in your application dependancies, which is highly unusual.

Thanks
-Andy
